flaps._comment: A310-300 slat/flap system uses combined slat/flap configurations: CONF 0/0, CONF 15/0, CONF 15/15, CONF 30/20, and CONF 30/40. Speed values are provisional A300/A310-family compatibility values pending add-on-specific verification.

grades._comment: A310 narrowbody-widebody hybrid. Structural limits similar to A300-600 family.

aircraftCfg._comment: Use the A310 designator only when the title or creator also identifies the included Microsoft/iniBuilds A310-300 package.

telemetry._comment: No A310-specific LVAR is active. Official iniBuilds support publishes several control inputs, but exact readback semantics remain unverified; the dedicated page therefore uses standard SimConnect fields.

controls._comment: The dedicated page is monitoring-only. No A310-specific cockpit writes are active; only Flight Fabric's narrow standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed.

meta.notes: Dedicated monitoring-first page and identity profile for the Microsoft / iniBuilds Airbus A310-300. Approach category D follows the referenced A310 range. Standard SimConnect is the only active telemetry source; unverified aircraft-specific FCP and parking-brake readbacks are inactive, and aircraft-specific cockpit writes remain disabled. Flap labels retain the documented slat/flap configurations for pilot reference.
